name: Level Recorder
description: Record macros and render lag-free videos of your runs, completions included, with optional microphone.

ffmpeg-path.name: FFmpeg path
ffmpeg-path.description: Path to ffmpeg.exe, or just <cy>ffmpeg</c> if it is on your PATH.

codec.name: Video codec
codec.description: ffmpeg video encoder. Use an *_nvenc / *_amf / *_qsv encoder for GPU encoding.

tail-seconds.name: Completion tail (seconds)
tail-seconds.description: How long to keep rendering after the level is completed (end screen).

include-music.name: Add level music to render
include-music.description: Muxes the level's song into the video. Sound effects are not captured.
